name: ¿Where is Annie?
source:
A group of friends loses a friend, disappearing for weeks without a trace. Some think it's normal (she always does), but Camille (who you play with) knows that this time it's different, so she sets out to investigate Annie's whereabouts.

[From [url=https://connimin.itch.io/where-is-annie]Itch.io[/url]]
